fruits.extendedStory: Work began in 1237 and the style is Gothic. The church belongs to Martin of Tours. The story told of him is that he met a beggar in the cold. He drew his sword and cut his own cloak in half to share it. A church on this scale in a town this small tells you the place once had money to spend.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Arbeiten begannen 1237, der Stil ist gotisch. Die Kirche gehört Martin von Tours. Von ihm erzählt man, er habe im Frost einen Bettler getroffen. Er zog sein Schwert und teilte seinen Mantel. Eine Kirche dieser Größe in einer so kleinen Stadt verrät, dass der Ort einmal Geld hatte.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Work began in 1237 and the style is Gothic. The church belongs to Martin of Tours. The story told of him is that he met a beggar in the cold. He drew his sword and cut his own cloak in half to share it. A church on this scale in a town this small tells you the place once had money to spend.

localizedStory.de: Eine gotische Kirche von 1237, benannt nach Martin von Tours, dem Soldaten, der seinen Mantel teilte.
localizedStory.en: A Gothic church begun in 1237, under the name of Martin of Tours, the soldier who cut his cloak in two.

fruits.name: Collégiale Saint-Martin
fruits.story: A Gothic church begun in 1237, under the name of Martin of Tours, the soldier who cut his cloak in two.

fruits.extendedStory: The Issenheim altarpiece was painted by Matthias Grunewald between 1512 and 1516, over carving by Nicolas de Haguenau from about 1490. It was made for the Antonite house at Issenheim. Their hospital treated a burning sickness that came from ergot growing in the rye. Patients were brought in front of this painting as part of their care. It was not made for a gallery wall, and it does not behave like something that was.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Den Isenheimer Altar malte Matthias Grunewald zwischen 1512 und 1516, über Schnitzwerk von Nicolas de Haguenau aus der Zeit um 1490. Gemacht wurde er für das Antoniterhaus in Isenheim. Dessen Spital behandelte eine brennende Krankheit, die vom Mutterkorn im Roggen kam. Man führte die Kranken vor dieses Bild, als Teil ihrer Pflege. Für eine Museumswand war es nicht gedacht, und so verhält es sich auch nicht.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Issenheim altarpiece was painted by Matthias Grunewald between 1512 and 1516, over carving by Nicolas de Haguenau from about 1490. It was made for the Antonite house at Issenheim. Their hospital treated a burning sickness that came from ergot growing in the rye. Patients were brought in front of this painting as part of their care. It was not made for a gallery wall, and it does not behave like something that was.

localizedStory.de: Hier hängt ein Altar, gemalt für ein Spital, zum Anschauen für Menschen, die schwer krank waren.
localizedStory.en: It holds an altarpiece painted for a hospital, to be looked at by people who were very ill.

fruits.name: Musée Unterlinden
fruits.story: It holds an altarpiece painted for a hospital, to be looked at by people who were very ill.

fruits.extendedStory: Ludwig Scherer was a hatter from Besancon, and in 1537 he had this house built. Look up for the corner oriel, two storeys tall, and the eight-sided turret with the spiral stair inside it. The walls carry painted emperors of the sixteenth century. The name on it now belongs to the Pfister family, who bought the place in 1841. The man who paid for it does not get his name on it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ludwig Scherer war Hutmacher aus Besancon und ließ 1537 dieses Haus bauen. Schau hinauf zum Eckerker über zwei Geschosse und zum achteckigen Türmchen mit der Wendeltreppe darin. Auf den Wänden stehen gemalte Kaiser des sechzehnten Jahrhunderts. Der Name daran gehört der Familie Pfister, die das Haus 1841 kaufte. Der Mann, der es bezahlte, steht nicht daran.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Ludwig Scherer was a hatter from Besancon, and in 1537 he had this house built. Look up for the corner oriel, two storeys tall, and the eight-sided turret with the spiral stair inside it. The walls carry painted emperors of the sixteenth century. The name on it now belongs to the Pfister family, who bought the place in 1841. The man who paid for it does not get his name on it.

localizedStory.de: 1537 von einem Hutmacher gebaut. 1841 nach einer Familie benannt, die es schlicht kaufte.
localizedStory.en: Built in 1537 by a hatter. Named in 1841 after a family who simply bought it.

fruits.name: Maison Pfister
fruits.story: Built in 1537 by a hatter. Named in 1841 after a family who simply bought it.

fruits.extendedStory: The building dates from 1480. Downstairs were warehouses and the place where goods coming in and going out were taxed. Upstairs the deputies of the Decapole met, the league of ten free Alsatian cities. The turret and the glazed tiles look thoroughly medieval. They are not. Both were put on during the restoration of 1895 to 1898.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau stammt von 1480. Unten lagen Lager und die Stelle, an der ein- und ausgehende Waren verzollt wurden. Oben tagten die Abgeordneten der Dekapolis, des Bundes von zehn freien elsässischen Städten. Türmchen und glasierte Ziegel wirken wie das Mittelalterlichste in Colmar. Sind sie nicht. Beides kam bei der Restaurierung von 1895 bis 1898 hinzu.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The building dates from 1480. Downstairs were warehouses and the place where goods coming in and going out were taxed. Upstairs the deputies of the Decapole met, the league of ten free Alsatian cities. The turret and the glazed tiles look thoroughly medieval. They are not. Both were put on during the restoration of 1895 to 1898.

localizedStory.de: Unten wurden Waren verzollt. Oben saßen zehn freie Städte zusammen und berieten.
localizedStory.en: Goods were taxed downstairs. Upstairs, ten free cities sat down together to talk.

fruits.name: Ancienne douane (Koïfhus)
fruits.story: Goods were taxed downstairs. Upstairs, ten free cities sat down together to talk.

fruits.extendedStory: Building began in 1289. The choir was done before 1300 and the nave by 1346. There is no transept at all, so the space runs straight through without interruption. Slender columns, wooden ceilings and fourteenth-century glass do the rest, and the result is a church full of light. In the choir stands Martin Schongauer's Virgin of the Rose Bower, painted in 1473.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau begann 1289. Der Chor war vor 1300 fertig, das Schiff bis 1346. Ein Querschiff fehlt ganz, der Raum läuft also ohne Unterbrechung durch. Schlanke Säulen, Holzdecken und Glas aus dem vierzehnten Jahrhundert tun das Übrige, und heraus kommt eine Kirche voller Licht. Im Chor steht Martin Schongauers Madonna im Rosenhag von 1473.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Building began in 1289. The choir was done before 1300 and the nave by 1346. There is no transept at all, so the space runs straight through without interruption. Slender columns, wooden ceilings and fourteenth-century glass do the rest, and the result is a church full of light. In the choir stands Martin Schongauer's Virgin of the Rose Bower, painted in 1473.

localizedStory.de: Kein Querschiff, schlanke Säulen und altes Glas. Darum ist es drinnen so hell.
localizedStory.en: No transept, slender columns, and old glass. That is why it is so bright inside.

fruits.name: Église des Dominicains
fruits.story: No transept, slender columns, and old glass. That is why it is so bright inside.

fruits.extendedStory: The abbey of Pairis put this building up in 1779, in the Neoclassical manner of straight lines and quiet fronts. It has changed hands repeatedly since. The department took it in 1790 and the prefecture from 1800. The town itself did not get it until 1866. Four owners in under a century is a fair summary of what happened to Alsace in that time.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Abtei Pairis errichtete dieses Haus 1779, klassizistisch, mit geraden Linien und ruhiger Front. Seither wechselte es mehrfach den Besitzer. 1790 nahm es das Departement, ab 1800 die Präfektur, und erst 1866 die Stadt selbst. Vier Besitzer in knapp einem Jahrhundert fassen ganz gut zusammen, was dem Elsass in dieser Zeit widerfuhr.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The abbey of Pairis put this building up in 1779, in the Neoclassical manner of straight lines and quiet fronts. It has changed hands repeatedly since. The department took it in 1790 and the prefecture from 1800. The town itself did not get it until 1866. Four owners in under a century is a fair summary of what happened to Alsace in that time.

localizedStory.de: Eine Abtei baute dieses Haus 1779. Seit 1866 verwaltet sich die Stadt von hier aus.
localizedStory.en: An abbey built this house in 1779. The town has run itself from it since 1866.

fruits.name: Hôtel de Ville de Colmar
fruits.story: An abbey built this house in 1779. The town has run itself from it since 1866.

fruits.extendedStory: Copper, hammered thin and worked at enormous size, made this household famous. Whoever grew up here gave America its torch-bearing woman. Belfort got its crouching lion from those same hands. Rooms passed into municipal ownership during 1907. Public admission followed on 18 November 1922, so visitors now cross floors where colossal figures began as small models.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Frederic Auguste Bartholdi wurde hier geboren. Er wurde Bildhauer, und zwei seiner Werke kennt man weit über Frankreich hinaus: die Freiheitsstatue und den Löwen von Belfort. Das Haus fiel 1907 an die Stadt und öffnete am 18. November 1922 als Museum. Eine Gestalt im Hafen von New York hat sich jemand ausgedacht, der in dieser Gasse aufwuchs.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Copper, hammered thin and worked at enormous size, made this household famous. Whoever grew up here gave America its torch-bearing woman. Belfort got its crouching lion from those same hands. Rooms passed into municipal ownership during 1907. Public admission followed on 18 November 1922, so visitors now cross floors where colossal figures began as small models.

localizedStory.de: Der Mann, der die Freiheitsstatue schuf, wurde in diesem Haus geboren.
localizedStory.en: A boy grew up in this house and later thought up a statue for New York harbour.

fruits.name: Musée Bartholdi
fruits.story: A boy grew up in this house and later thought up a statue for New York harbour.

fruits.extendedStory: The nave went up in 1292 for Franciscan friars. In 1575 the building passed to the Protestants. Then in 1715 a royal order put a wall straight across the inside. Two congregations could now use one church without meeting, and that wall stood until 1987. There is also a Silbermann organ of 1731, from the family whose organs are scattered across Alsace.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Kirchenschiff entstand 1292 für Franziskaner. 1575 ging der Bau an die Protestanten. 1715 zog ein königlicher Befehl eine Mauer quer durch das Innere, damit zwei Gemeinden eine Kirche nutzen konnten, ohne sich zu begegnen. Diese Mauer stand bis 1987. Dazu kommt eine Silbermann-Orgel von 1731, aus der Familie, deren Orgeln überall im Elsass stehen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The nave went up in 1292 for Franciscan friars. In 1575 the building passed to the Protestants. Then in 1715 a royal order put a wall straight across the inside. Two congregations could now use one church without meeting, and that wall stood until 1987. There is also a Silbermann organ of 1731, from the family whose organs are scattered across Alsace.

localizedStory.de: Eine Kirche, zwei Gemeinden, und jahrhundertelang eine Mauer mittendurch.
localizedStory.en: One church, two congregations, and a wall straight down the middle for centuries.

fruits.story: One church, two congregations, and a wall straight down the middle for centuries.
